tagline: Aliya's Cookies: dry-cookie production from Pondok Aren with a registered brand identity.

story.title: Aliya's Cookies: dry-cookie production from Pondok Aren with a registered brand identity.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists Aliya's Cookies under Eni Chandra Shanti in Pondok Aren, with nastar as the described product, 10 kg/month capacity and SPP-IRT plus Halal LPPOM MUI. The Aliya's Cookies mark also appears in an Indonesian trademark gazette under Eni Chandra Shanti.

stats.label: Aliya's Cookies appears in the DJKI gazette
